description: This file defines an interface IPersistentState<TState> in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which extends IStorage<TState> and provides access to grain state with methods to save, clear, and refresh state. It is part of the Orleans distributed virtual actor framework's runtime components.

classes.name: IPersistentState
classes.description: Interface for persistent grain state management, providing methods to save, clear, and refresh state, extending IStorage<TState>.
